lead.event: MSCI’s proposed downgrade and Indonesia’s market reforms
lead.headline: MSCI proposes standalone downgrade as IDX excludes 80 stocks from JCI
lead.blurb: MSCI opened a consultation on 15 October to reclassify Indonesia from emerging-market to standalone status, while freezing additions and weight increases in its indexes. From 2 November, the 80 stocks will remain listed and tradable, and their JCI weighting will be redistributed without changing the 30 October closing reference level. OJK has expanded ownership disclosures and investor classifications, but MSCI considers the measures insufficient to address its concerns. The consultation runs through 30 April 2027, with a final decision due by 30 June 2027.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The IDX will exclude 80 high-shareholding-concentration stocks from the JCI starting 2 November 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: DIM discloses Rp140 trillion in assets, targets US$5 billion note offering
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Danantara Investment Management's April 2026 report filed with the Singapore Exchange shows Rp123 trillion, or 87.9% of assets, in cash and equivalents, and Rp16.6 trillion in investments. DIM is targeting US$5 billion (about Rp89.28 trillion) through a Global Medium Term Note offering.

deals_control.event: BSDE affiliate agrees to buy land for data center development
deals_control.headline: DSSA affiliate agrees to buy BSDE land for Rp3.1 trillion
deals_control.blurb: Bumi Serpong Damai subsidiary Surya Inter Wisesa signed a binding sale-and-purchase agreement on 26 October with SMPlus Cakrawala Cipta Gemilang, a Dian Swastatika Sentosa subsidiary, for about 166,261 square meters in BSD City's D-Hub Special Economic Zone. Dian Swastatika Sentosa says the site will support SMPlus Cakrawala Cipta Gemilang's data center service development.

earnings_guidance.blurb: GoTo had repurchased nearly 3% of its shares and planned to cancel 32 billion treasury shares. Phintraco Sekuritas cut its target price from Rp80 to Rp40 while maintaining a buy recommendation.

earnings_guidance.event: Pan Brothers reports a nine-month 2026 net loss
earnings_guidance.headline: PBRX reports USD4.98 million nine-month 2026 net loss
earnings_guidance.blurb: Pan Brothers' revenue rose 11.71% to USD225.98 million, and operating profit reached USD2.98 million. Finance costs were USD8.01 million, while the year-earlier period included a USD101.56 million gain from debt modification.

earnings_guidance.event: Kiwoom Sekuritas lowers Bank Mandiri valuation and price target
earnings_guidance.headline: Kiwoom cuts BMRI valuation and price target despite 20.7% profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Kiwoom Sekuritas lowered its valuation and price target for Bank Mandiri amid rising market uncertainty. The bank’s nine-month 2026 net profit rose 20.7% year on year to Rp45.5 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Sinar Mas Multiartha reports nine-month 2026 earnings decline
earnings_guidance.headline: SMMA reports 24.60% nine-month profit decline
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sinar Mas Multiartha's revenue fell 8.06% to Rp27.37 trillion, mainly on lower insurance services revenue, and earnings per share dropped to Rp363 from Rp477. Shares ended October at Rp20,525, up 41.55% year to date.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK reports administrative sanctions through October 2026
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK reports Rp500 billion Anbo fine in sanctions through October
market_structure_policy.blurb: The sanctions through 31 October covered trading violations, internal-control breaches and anti-money-laundering rules. Tigonis Capital Pte Ltd was fined Rp100 billion, while institutional fines on 16 October ranged from Rp700 million to Rp1.5 billion.
